parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: The configuration ID. You can call the [ListRedirectRules](~~2867474~~) operation to obtain the configuration ID.

parameters.name: ReserveQueryString
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to preserve the query string. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
The rule content. A conditional expression is used to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: The execution order of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

parameters.name: StatusCode
parameters.description:
The HTTP status code used when the node responds to the client with the redirect address. Valid values:

- 301
- 302
- 303
- 307
- 308

parameters.name: TargetUrl
parameters.description: The target URL after the redirect.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The redirect type. Valid values:

- static: static pattern.
- dynamic: dynamic pattern.
